_note: render_art.py가 이 발주서로 Gemini 2.5 Flash Image(나노바나나)를 호출해 assets/art/<id>.png 생성. id는 웹툰 패널 순서와 일치(center-1..6, cargo-1..6). 웹툰이 그 PNG가 있으면 자동으로 진짜 작화 표시, 없으면 SVG 폴백.
style: Korean webtoon / manhwa style illustration, full color, cinematic dramatic lighting, vertical webtoon panel, high detail, no text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no watermark

shots.prompt: A vast empty concert stage in near-darkness. One dramatic golden spotlight beams down from the overhead rigging onto center stage. A confident young male K-pop idol (DOKYUNG) — ash-blonde swept-back hair, pristine white-and-silver stage outfit — walks into the light and stands facing the camera with a faint cold smirk. Behind him a huge dim LED screen glows with a breaking-news lower-third. Foreground: dark silhouettes of an empty audience and TV cameras. Moody, glamorous, high contrast, volumetric haze, wide shot.

A dim idol company backstage dressing room. A slim young male trainee (SEOHA) — dark messy fringe, oversized charcoal hoodie — stands small and alone, seen from behind, looking up at a huge glowing framed memorial portrait of an idol who resembles him (his late brother SEOJUN). Row of vanity mirror bulbs. Magenta and warm backlight, reverent, lonely, strong scale contrast.

A pitch-black idol practice room with a mirrored wall. A smartphone lies on the floor emitting an intense cyan glow and a ghostly audio waveform rising like a spirit. SEOHA (dark fringe, charcoal hoodie) kneels beside it, one hand reaching for the play button, face uplit cyan, eyes wide with shock. Eerie, high contrast, cinematic.

Close cinematic shot of SEOHA standing, his face and body split by two hard lights — the left half in hot magenta, the right half in cold cyan — torn, conflicted expression, jaw tight. Extreme chiaroscuro, dramatic, symbolic dilemma, dark background.

A night agency corridor. A weary man in his 30s (MANAGER) with glasses and a navy suit carries a cardboard box of belongings, pausing to glance back over his shoulder with a tired, knowing half-smile. Warm light spills from an open doorway ahead; SEOHA watches from the foreground in silhouette. Melancholy, cinematic depth.

A huge comeback live broadcast stage flooded with golden beams. SEOHA stands at the center microphone facing forward, spotlit. Behind him, frozen silhouettes of idol members; a cyan audio waveform scatters through the air. A red ON AIR indicator glows; TV cameras loom in the foreground. Everyone frozen. Climactic wide dramatic shot.

A dim industrial space dock. A worn, battered cargo hauler ship is docked among dark gantries with small amber and red warning lights. A glowing cyan corporate mission hologram floats near the ship. A weathered ship captain (DOHYUN) — greying temples, stubble, olive flight jacket — stands small on a gantry facing the hologram. Cold, last-chance mood, cinematic.

A small lone cargo ship crossing a vast starfield with a faint magenta-and-cyan nebula. In the foreground drifts the wreck of a broken astronaut helmet with a faint blinking distress light. Silent, lonely, cold, cinematic deep-space wide shot.

A derelict abandoned space station silhouetted against the dark, glowing with a pulsing cyan distress beacon; an alluring ghostly female face (a SIREN) shimmers faintly in one lit window. A young engineer (LUKA) with goggles pushed up on his forehead drifts entranced toward it, while the captain's hand grabs his arm to stop him. Eerie cyan glow, tense, cinematic.

Interior of a ribbed metal cargo hold, dim. A large shipping container has been opened, revealing an ominous amber hazard / redacted classified mark glowing inside. The captain (DOHYUN) stands before it in silhouette, realizing the truth. Dramatic amber light, shadow, cinematic.

Inside a spaceship cockpit, seen from behind the captain (DOHYUN) at the helm controls, his hand turning the ship around. Through the large curved window: a field of stars and the siren station receding into the distance. Warm console glow on his silhouette, determined, cinematic.

A small ship arriving at a dark, dead space dock. A large red notice screen reads as CLOSED/SOLD (no legible text), the gantries unlit except one red light. A corporate comms hologram flickers and cuts off. Bleak, cold, final, cinematic wide shot.
